Gaw-La Furia - Throne Room
Shana-Mia
At this rate, the Earthlings' suspicions will only@deepen. If the <Gate of Voda> does not@settle down...
I judge that we should reveal the truth to them and@negotiate, then after recovering the Throne Unit,@cooperate with them in case the worst happens.
Da-Nia
But, Your Highness...@That would go against the late Emperor's wishes.
Gu-Landon
Indeed.@The reason we have repeated our long slumbers@here in Gaw-La Furia...
...is so that the Fury as a race, and our wisdom,@do not degrade as the environment changes and@the generations pass.
Moreover, cooperating with Earthlings,@who are inferior to us, is out of the question.
My father respected their existence as the native@inhabitants. That is why, when we reached this@planet, he forbade us to interfere.
Looking back on their history since, I believe@we should have ruled them early on.
The Fury's history has been much the same.
Do you mean to deny an empire that has@lasted for millennia?
And in my generation, even that@merely lingers on, barely...
Even so, we cannot meet our end@on a backwater planet such as this.
...My father once said that our reaching Earth@after our wandering may have been the guidance@of Fureim, the god of creation.
And that a great power of destiny@is at work on that planet.
That is why I believe the Throne Unit was able to@seal the Gate of Voda in the past battle@against the <Vaula>.
That was surely thanks to the late Emperor's@extraordinary power.
Then he should have been able to seal the Gate of@Voda in the final battle on the Fury homeworld.
Perhaps Granteed's power manifested@precisely because it was on Earth...
I cannot agree with that.
But Earth had a Gate of Voda too.@Didn't Fureim know of it?
I acknowledge Granteed's supernatural power...@But if the god of creation dwells within it, I cannot@understand why it let our homeworld perish.
But it is a fact that we survivors, and the@Earthlings, were saved from the Vaula@by the Throne Unit.
Then how do you explain our current situation?@A trial given by the gods, like Tou-Lauza's@Thousand-Night Journey in the myths?
Perhaps it is...
Then we shall simply overcome it.@Even a counterfeit was able to push back the Vaula.
With the Zee-Gadin, soon to be complete,@I shall show you even greater results.
Even so, the absence of Granteed, guardian deity of@Gaw-La Furia, is unsettling. It affects the morale@of the Squires as well.
Given our last failure, the only sure way to get it@back is for two Raftclans to use <Larseilam>.@What say you?
In other words, you'd have us leave the operation@to retake Granteed not to us knights,@but to the <Agent> corps.
Ideally, I would ask Her Highness@to approve the use of Larseilam@by knights, but...
With no new Eitelum to be had,@we can use it only a limited number of times.
Larseilam is one of our trump cards.@We should save it in case the worst happens.
Karo-Ran
True, the remaining Raftclans made heavy use of@that device in the last great war, so there's no@telling how many more times it can be used...
If it is to retrieve the Throne Unit,@So-Des and I shall go.
(...I'd like to conserve our own Eitelum, but@I don't care to let this one owe me more than@necessary.)
Karo-Ran,@I cannot permit any further use of Larseilam.
Then leave it to us, the Knights.
That is my intention, but I will personally@choose the knight who sorties.
(What...?)
Al-Van Ranks.
Sir!
I leave it to you. Do you understand why?
You wish me to retrieve the Throne Unit while@stirring up as little trouble with the Earthlings@as possible?
Yes, for the sake of what comes later.
(Her Highness is naive.@As if such a thing were possible at this point.)
Is that acceptable, Gu-Landon?
(So the time has come to see@which side Al-Van will take...)
As you wish, Your Highness. Al-Van, this is the@chance granted to you after your string of failures.@Retrieve the Throne Unit, and do it well.
(After this... there may be no next time.)
Gaw-La Furia - Interior
Jua-Mu
Why won't you take me with you...?!
I don't want to close off your future.@Of all those under me, you're the one@closest to becoming a knight.
That's only thanks to your guidance, Lord Al-Van.@That's exactly why I want to help you.
It could also get in the way of the other@reason you seek to become a knight.
You talk as though the operation@were going to fail.
I'm only assuming the worst.
Then we just have to retrieve the Throne Unit@successfully. I'll give it everything I have.
I appreciate how you feel, but this time,@stand by. That is a strict order.
...Sir.
(Lord Al-Van isn't the type of man who'd@try to keep all the glory for himself...)
(The reason he won't let me join@the next operation... Is it that woman after all?)
Pakistan - Karachi District
Steel Dragons
Hiryu Custom, Mess Hall
Man, I'm starving!
For me, it's more sleepy than hungry...
We went right out on patrol@after we got back.
Thanks for your hard work, everyone.
These seats just opened up. Go ahead.
Yep.
Is the ATX Team on standby next?
That's right.
Huh?@Isn't the shift change a little later?
Since we got to rest first, our shift will be longer.@Gotta check our units thoroughly.
Well, see you.
I'd rather have a longer shift later@if it meant resting right away.
It's a rotation, so no hard feelings.
Well, you'd better pray there's no enemy@attack while we're on break.
Ugh... I've got a bad feeling about this.
What?!@You saying the enemy'll come just 'cause I said it?!
Well, you know, sometimes what you say@comes true, right?
Tenia
Whaaat, that's bad! I gotta eat fast!
Melua
Tenia, what Lieutenant Katina says has@nothing to do with what the enemy does.
Then do I have time for another helping?
Katia
You really do eat a lot.
Can't I?
It's almost time for patrol, but one more bowl@should be fine.
Huh, Touya... You're not eating anymore?@It'd be a waste to leave it.
...Then you can have it.
Really?!
No. I heard that eating properly@is part of a pilot's job.
Were you thinking about the Fury, by any chance?
...Yeah.@I still don't really understand those people.
There's no use rushing it. Someday...
The time will come when I understand, huh?@Right, they're after Granteed. If they catch me,@maybe a lot of my questions will get answered.
What's that supposed to mean?@You want to go over to them?
I don't want that.@I absolutely don't want to be caught by them.
Ah, no... I didn't mean it seriously.
Hey, Touya.@Instead of overthinking things, eat up and rest.@If you've got no stamina, you'll be in trouble.
Oh, even the Lieutenant once in a while...
Ow!
Leave out the "once in a while"!
Ahaha, and I hadn't even finished talking.
Wow, that was a quick hand~
There's always someone better, huh?
Better at what, exactly?
Anyway, eat, Touya.@That's what you need to be doing right now.
...Understood.
Touya...
Don't worry. I'm not acting out of desperation.@I'll eat properly and go on patrol.
Hiryu Custom Hangar
About your request: it's been approved upstairs.
Roger.
Who'd have thought the commander would OK it?
Before that, I thought it would@stop with Lieutenant Kyosuke.
He may not look it, but our captain's@surprisingly earnest.
That's not much of a defense.
Oh my.
(The Lieutenant says nothing. He's just@naturally like this. Compared to them, we...)
(No, trying to remember the old days...@What's wrong with me?)
Hm? What?
Nothing... Well, I'll go on patrol, then.
...Lieutenant Calvina was walking@toward the Bellzelute.@Is she heading out?
Yes, she put in the request herself.
Huh?@Wasn't Lieutenant Calvina on the reserve shift?
She should have been.
If the Lamaris don't reappear,@we won't have to bother with patrols.
(A reason to go outside right now, of all times...)
I don't think it's a good idea@for Granteed and the Bellzelute@to be outside at a time like this...
I agree, but the commander approved it.
That's what's so surprising.
It may be orders from even higher up.
Higher than the commander...
The Joint Chiefs of Staff, I'd guess.
(Drawing the Fury's attention is one of@the Lefina Detachment's roles, but...)
(A reason to lure them out at this timing...@Operation Triumph, perhaps.)
The Bellzelute... Why did you come out?
Am I in the way?
No... But is this all right?
I got permission from above.
(Could it be that the reason@Calvina came out is...)
(If you're watching, then come, Fury...@No, Al-Van Ranks.@I'm right here.)
Eun
Gravity quake reading above us!@Something seems to be transferring in!
The ES wave pattern@closely matches the Fury's!
All hands, level one battle stations!@Prepare for anti-air combat!@All mobile units, launch immediately!
...Good, just as planned.
Heh, heh heh.
Calvina?
Things are going exactly as planned.@But I won't call it fate.
Today, here, I sever my ties with him.
All mobile units, launch immediately!
Raji
No readings in the combat zone of a black@Raftclans or a small teleportation device.
That Raftclans has never used@that trick... Will it be the same this time?
Who knows?@The marker we got from Major Gilliam@can be fired at any time, though.
They're not so naive that@the same trick would work twice.
...Al-Van won't use that trick.
How can you say that for certain?
I have no proof. It's just what I think.
Are you saying you understand him?
Don't get the wrong idea.@I'm going to kill him with my own hands.@I'll use anything to make that happen.
Calvina...
Calvina...
Then show me, Calvina Coulange.
You don't need to tell me.
Sean
Captain, shall we recall@Granteed and the Bellzelute?
No, I want to narrow down the conditions for that@trick a little more. This ship and Granteed will@hold position. Don't let enemy units get close.
And you're leaving Lieutenant Calvina@out there on purpose?
Yes. We may be able to get information@about the Fury out of Al-Van Ranks.
(A harsh decision.@But that is exactly as it should be.)
Touya, don't move from there.
But Al-Van knows my father's secret.@I have to get it out of him...
If you get carried off before that, Touya,@there'd be no point, right?
Ugh...
Touya... You're not the only one who wants@the truth. Leave this to us.
Touya... You're not the only one who wants@the truth. You'd better leave this to everyone.
...O-Okay, understood.
Hiryu escort units, protect Granteed too.@If the Raftclans shows any sign@of using that trick, be a wall.
To keep enemy units from making@physical contact, right?
Right.@All other units, spread out and hit the enemy force.@We can't afford to take our time.
Roger.
Hell, I'll grab that Al-Van guy@and make him spill everything.
I'm the one who'll deal with that man.@I won't let anyone else do it.
(He'll come after the Bellzelute...@If Touya and the others can't move,@I have to get the truth out of him.)
(Calvina is using me...@And I'm using Calvina too...)
(In the end, we're even. So I have to do this...)
Let's go, Katia!
Right!
(Whatever Calvina thinks of me,@I want to know the truth...@That's why I'm here.)
(And I'm definitely gonna get it out of him!)
Let's go, Tenia!
Right!
(I don't want to be caught by him, by the Fury...)
(So whatever Calvina thinks of me,@I'll support her... to get the answers.)
Let's go, Melua!
Yes...!
(Karin, this is the last chance.@For you... and for me as well.)
Calvina, a transmission@from the Raftclans...!
What will you do?
...Put it through.
Calvina, a transmission@from the Raftclans...!
Wanna ignore it?
...No, put it through.
Calvina,@a transmission from the Raftclans...!
Wh-What will you do?
Can you hear me, Karin?
Still using that name...@No, that doesn't matter.@I've been dying to see you, Al-Van.
I'd like to think you answered my call@because you understood my intentions.
Understood... Understood, huh?@Do you know how happy I am@to finally meet you like this?
Happy?
That's right.@Ally... the man called Alistair Lynx@was everything to me.
So I'll stake everything on killing you...@Al-Van. With my own hands...!
I understand your anger... but there's been@a misunderstanding. I meant to tell you the facts@and then...
Like I'd believe any facts out of your mouth!@I'm settling it here! Everything between us!
Touya, Calvina is...!
(What is this...? How can I tell?@It's not her--I'm the one sensing it.)
Touya, Calvina's...!
(What is this...? How can I tell?@It's not her--I'm the one sensing it.)
Touya, Calvina is...!
(What is this...? How can I tell?@It's not her--I'm the one sensing it.)
(Karin... So you still won't listen.@Then...!)
(The Steel Dragons... They drove us this far with@half their strength. If they were ever to invade@Gaw-La...)
(No, even that would be used by that man...@That's why I...)
...All units, fall back. I'll handle the rest.
(I must tell her the truth...)
You're not getting away!!
I can tell you've cast off your doubts...@but that's exactly why your moves are so@straightforward and easy to read.
Sore loser!@You think you can turn this around?!
It's true that, knowing the Steel Dragons' record,@I still underestimated their strength.
Then die with your regrets!@That'll be my offering to my dead comrades!
Listen, Karin.@I was not the one who attacked@the Ashurey Kreuzer.
Begging for your life now?!@Then how do you explain what Jua-Mu said?!
The project under way on the Ashurey was meant@to bring a new future@to us, the Fury...
So you deceived us and used us!@You killed everyone on the Ashurey!
I can't blame you for seeing it that way.@And neither I nor Lord E-Selda@could save them...
Spare me your drivel!
It all began with the Gate of Voda.@And to dispel the calamity@it would bring...
we must get Granteed back, no matter what.@And I want you, too...
Fu-Ruu
That's enough, Al-Van.
Fu-Ruu...!
Lord Gu-Landon's orders.@Withdraw at once, Al-Van Ranks.
Wait, I...!
I don't know what you two were discussing...@but if you were telling her the truth to persuade@her, that would amount to high treason.
You have failed your mission. Withdraw at once.@That's my advice as a friend.
And if I refuse?
Then I'll carry out Lord Gu-Landon's orders.@And it won't just be you--@your subordinates will suffer for it too.
Ngh...
If you return now, I'll intercede for you.@We can avoid the worst.@Come, let's go.
...Understood.
Al-Van!!
All enemy signals in the combat area are gone!
(Don't think I'll see this as you sparing me,@Al-Van.)
...In the end, they never used that trick.
Yes...
So he was after us, too?!
He's coming after us!
And I thought he wouldn't come after us...
I felt Calvina's emotions surge!@Al-Van, what were you talking about?!
(So he's learned to sense that much...@Targeting him in this situation was worth it.)
Karin, listen to me.@We don't have much time left.
Shut up! All I need is the instant@it takes to slit your throat!
No sign of them using that trick@after all...!
If we can just get through this, we'll buy time!@Time to build the frame!
You're wary that I'll use Larseilam?@A wise judgment, I'll grant.
Are you saying you were waiting@for the right moment to appear?
I don't intend to waste this chance.
We can't let Lieutenant Calvina@face him one-on-one...!
Your timing's way too good.@Proof the thread of fate's still intact, maybe?
Don't come between Karin and me...!
It wasn't enough, but I got some rest.@I'll hold my own even against a Raftclans!
They fight well, considering how long this battle@has gone on. Is that what makes them who they are?
So it went just like Tasuku said!@And it's a Raftclans we're up against, too!
There is something I must do.@I'll have you stand aside!
Tch, my bad feeling was right on the mark,@but I can't let his attacks hit the mark!
I have no time to deal with you...!
You'll challenge us head-on without that trick?@Then I'll answer that spirit!
This is no opponent I can easily brush aside...@I have no choice but to take you on!
(He didn't use that trick as his opening move...@I doubt Gilliam's marker is still acting@as a deterrent, though.)
(A strategy that doesn't use Larseilam@will sow doubt in their hearts...)
Such resistance with half their strength.@They seem to have a fine set of warriors.
He seems resolute, and yet he also seems@to harbor the slightest doubt.@Now then, which is it...?
Just as Calvina said, you won't use that trick.@What's the reason?
There is something I must accomplish in this@battle. If you stand in my way, I'll cut you down...!
I'll get the truth out of him in Touya's place...!
(It may be a counterfeit, but it served as a key.@I have no wish to fight that machine.)
Anyone Josh deems an enemy, I will eliminate.
To think the <Vaula> would coexist@with Earthlings like this...
Al-Van Ranks...@I was testing you in this operation.
You put contact with the Earthlings ahead of@retaking the Throne Unit. According to Fu-Ruu's@report, you don't seem to have leaked our secrets...
But if you won't destroy the Bellzelute,@you can hardly complain if you're suspected@of divided loyalties.
I merely acted in accordance@with Her Highness's wishes.
Aren't your personal feelings for the@Bellzelute's pilot also involved?
You don't deny it?
...At this point, I will not lie.
So you're the same as E-Selda. I do not accept the@Assimilation Plan, whatever Her Highness's wishes,@nor anyone who supports it.
Your sentence will be decided in due time.@Until then, you'll remain confined in a cell.
Hiryu Custom - Briefing Room
...Lieutenant Calvina,@I've finished listening to the record@of your communication with Al-Van Ranks.
It seems he wanted to clear up@your misunderstanding, Lieutenant.
...Yes.
Taken at face value, his words mean the Fury has@both those who attacked the <Ashurey Kreuzer>@and those who tried to stop them.
...Like I'd believe that.
But if it's true, it changes our understanding.@The latter may be Earthlings.
If, as we've long suspected,@there are Earthlings cooperating with the Fury,@and E-Selda, alias Seldoa, is one of them...
That would explain why Touya is an Earthling.
Are you saying Al-Van is one too?
I'd rather ask you that.@You're the one who knew him well@before the incident.
(I never once thought my dad was an alien.)
Well?
...I thought he was an Earthling.@That man acted like one, too.@There was no room for doubt.
In private as well?
You don't mince words.
I'm well aware it's tactless.
My answer's the same.@I can't believe a single thing about that man.
But wasn't Al-Van trying@to clear up your misunderstanding?
Whatever the man who deceived me says...@That's right, like I'd believe his hands are clean.@I'll take him down myself, no matter what.
Whether we can trust those words@depends on what you do from here on.
...Of course.
What concerns me is the project that was@supposedly under way on the Ashurey Kreuzer.
Al-Van said it would bring@a new future to the Fury...
The thing that comes to mind with the Ashurey@is the Bellzelute.
Lieutenant Calvina, any ideas?
I'm a hired test pilot.@I don't know anything about their plans.
But if you were on the Ashurey Kreuzer,@you can't be completely uninvolved.
Then the same goes for Katia, Tenia, and Melua.@It seems those girls were called to the moon@to activate the Cytron System.
(Is that really all there is to it...?)
If you can't trust us,@want to redo the questioning?
No, that won't be necessary.
The last thing that caught my attention was the@Gate of Voda. If it brings calamity, then it's like...
...the <Cross Gate>, huh?
...Pardon the interruption during the debriefing.@Captain, we've received word from Commander Miles.
Operation Triumph was a success.@Paris has been freed from the Lamaris.
I see...@That's welcome news.
The Hagane will be resupplied and repaired at@Aviano Base. The Hiryu Custom is to join it there.
Understood.
